name: Rahul Kumar Lohra
headline: Staff-level Android Platform Engineer
summary: Android platform engineer with 10+ years of experience building reliable mobile foundations, SDKs, and developer tools. I specialize in platform architecture, real-time communication, performance, and engineering standards that help teams build with confidence.

experience.summary: Building a more reliable Android Video SDK, from WebRTC reconnection and incoming calls to audio routing and core SDK architecture.
highlights: Architected a two-tier WebRTC reconnection strategy using existing ICE connectivity and full ICE re-establishment, informed by Android network changes and WebSocket health.
Reworked incoming-call ringing with polling fallback and ringing-attempt management to handle WebSocket disconnections.
Improved Android Telecom and Bluetooth audio integration, addressing concurrency, audio routing, permissions, and call-state consistency.
Modernized call management, camera lifecycle, authentication, and notification pipelines in the Android Video SDK.

experience.summary: Led Android architecture and developer tooling work across product teams, with a focus on reusable foundations, performance, and engineering standards.
highlights: Led five engineers in designing and standardizing ASSEM, an Android architecture library covering UI, communication, and ViewModel layers, with adoption across four business lines.
Built internal code analysis tools and lint/CI enforcement pipelines to improve architectural consistency across seven business lines.
Optimized runtime performance through work including mmap-based file I/O and migrated concurrency from RxJava/Bolts to Kotlin Coroutines.
Aligned with international stakeholders and streamlined an aspect-oriented programming framework to support broader adoption.

experience.summary: Managed three engineers across the DeHaat Business and AIMS apps, improving authentication, build consistency, and testing practices.
highlights: Improved authentication flows using OpenID/AppAuth and worked with Firebase Remote Config and Datadog.
Standardized Gradle scripts to reduce redundant code, project size, and dependency conflicts.
Delivered a team session on unit testing with JUnit and MockK.

experience.summary: Led Android teams and built reusable platform components and tools, supporting performance, delivery, and engineering quality.
highlights: Led five to eight engineers across app domains, guiding delivery, mentoring, and architectural decisions.
Improved UI performance through profiling and rendering optimization, and built reusable global-dialog and media-picker components used across seven teams.
Developed API mocking tools, the GraphQL Formatter IntelliJ plugin, and CI test optimizations to improve developer workflows.
Drove Clean Architecture, Kotlin Coroutines/Flow, and MockK adoption while contributing to hiring, training, and technical leadership.

experience.summary: Built Android media and camera features, including collage, Boomerang, video, and GIF creation with FFmpeg.
highlights: Worked on face detection, map clustering, SQLite, notifications, and background services.
Integrated REST APIs, multithreaded processing, camera and storage features, and image loading with Glide, Picasso, and Fresco.

experience.summary: Built commerce and service integrations for the InOne Android app.
highlights: Integrated PayU, Ixigo, Zomato, Ola, and Uber services, along with REST APIs, Google Maps, and Places.
Implemented shopping-cart management, checkout, and Android UI features.

experience.summary: Built messaging, file sharing, payments, and social sign-in features for Android.
highlights: Created an XMPP chat module with the Smack API, Stripe payments, and Google, Facebook, and LinkedIn sign-in.
Implemented sharing for camera images and documents, using tools including Dagger 2, Retrofit, Glide, MVP, and Stetho.
